name: xiao-ui-theme-ts
author: jinxlux
description: Customizable theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness web UI. Ships with a Xiao-style jade palette by default; accent color, mascot badge text, injected voice and frosted background are all configurable. Built with TypeScript and pnpm.

dshCompat.boundaryNote: The dividing line is whether the DSH build ships the official right panel (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right, first published as v0.1.5-alpha.1). Compatibility is keyed on the DSH version only.

dsh.recommendedNote: Use this release (0.12.0) or a later one.
dsh.mismatchNote: Picking against this table does not crash (the plugin still loads and DSH still starts), but UI bugs may appear - for example the sidebar / right panel background or transparency can be wrong.
dsh.auditedNote: Every published @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right build (v0.1.5-alpha.1 ... 0.1.7-rc.2) was unpacked and checked: 0.1.5-alpha.1 - 0.1.6-alpha.2 paint their own panel and have no data-sidebar-right-session marker; 0.1.7-alpha.1 and newer do not paint it and do carry the marker.

betterSidebar.note: Recorded for reference only - it takes no part in the version choice above. Legacy <=0.18 (self-drawn right panel) is not adapted to any more; the legacy anchors stay in the CSS so nothing crashes, but the look is not guaranteed.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('lib',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync('.build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build-host.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build-client.json && node scripts/wrap-client.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node test/host.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs
